historical_unavailable_noise.title: Older recorded history may include unnecessary "unavailable" states
historical_unavailable_noise.description:
A now-fixed bug made every LK Systems sensor briefly show "unavailable" on any single failed cloud request, even ones that recovered moments later. You may have some of that recorded in your history from before upgrading - it's harmless and doesn't affect anything going forward.

Cleaning it up is optional, and **deletes all recorded history for every LK Systems sensor** - temperature, pressure, water usage, everything, not just the unavailable states - **and can't be undone.** Only continue if you're fine losing that history. To do it anyway: go to your Home Assistant URL + `/developer-tools/action`, search for and select **Purge Recorder entities**, check **Domains to remove** and type `- lksystems` into the box, then select **Perform action**.
